status: provisional engineering choices; not user-specified numerical requirements
user_requirements: single-microphone drone presence even with interference
file input and recorded continuous-stream replay
independent audio evaluation and an honest operating range

intended_scope.capture: single microphone; devices not yet supplied or measured
intended_scope.environments: stationary outdoor capture initially; wind and other conditions unmeasured
intended_scope.drone_variety: unknown until audio provenance is established
intended_scope.interference: fans, leaf blowers, lawnmowers, traffic, speech, music, aircraft
intended_scope.live_microphone: not verified; no audio capture device in the current cloud instance

annotation.event: audibly present drone corroborated by recording log or synchronized video; uncertain boundaries excluded
annotation.ambiguous: exclude ambiguous time from negative exposure and matching; never infer absence from a filename
annotation.negative: fully reviewed audio with no drone, including intervals between verified events

decision.selection: development only: prefer point FA/h <= 1, then highest event recall, lowest p95 delay, lowest FA/h, highest threshold; otherwise lowest FA/h then highest recall

freeze: Freeze candidate, train-only preprocessing, split, decision, contract and demo IDs before final evaluation. A reused final set becomes development evidence.
uncertainty: 95% session/component cluster bootstrap (2000 replicates); supplement with Poisson exposure interval (explicit stationarity assumption) and event-binomial interval (explicit independence assumption), take conservative bounds. Neither substitutes for coverage or independent capture.
